title: 第161章 关注重点第160章 进步与提升
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
即便从未踏足中心主斗魂场，外围观众对这八个神秘魂师的好奇与追捧，也早已到了令人难以招架的地步。
为了避免不必要的麻烦和纠缠，从十天前开始，大师便定下规矩：一行人以本来面目进入斗魂场，再到指定的隐秘角落换上统一的深色劲装、戴好遮面面具后再报名参赛。
也正因如此，猜测史莱克八怪会在哪个分斗魂区现身，成了外围观众们乐此不疲的消遣，每当某个分斗魂场出现实力强劲的匿名队伍，总会引发一阵“是不是史莱克八怪”的热议。
今天依旧如此，众人都换上了最朴素的粗布衣衫，颜色暗沉的布料洗得有些发白，恰好掩盖了少年少女们身上逐渐显露的锋芒。
唐三穿着灰蓝色短打，袖口磨出了细微的毛边，眼眸沉静如水，混在人群中毫不起眼。
马红俊的衣衫略显宽松，遮住了微微发福的身形，嘴角偶尔勾起的坏笑，还带着几分少年人的跳脱。小舞扎着简单的马尾，粉色发梢在灯火下若隐若现，蹦蹦跳跳地跟在马红俊唐三身边，手指不自觉地缠着腰间的软甲丝带。
宁荣荣褪去了华丽服饰，素色衣裙衬得肌肤胜雪，眉宇间偶尔闪过的傲娇，还残留着几分小公主的模样；
戴沐白走在最前方开路，身形挺拔如松，眼神锐利如鹰，不经意间流露的气势，总能让周围的人群下意识地退让；奥斯卡嚼着自制的香肠，慢悠悠地跟在宁荣荣身旁，嘴里还不时念叨着即将到来的比赛；
朱竹清一身黑衣，身形纤细得如同未长成的小兽，作为队伍中年纪最小的成员，她的眼神比同龄人更显清冷坚毅，脚步轻盈却沉稳，偶尔抬眼扫视四周时，眼底的警惕毫不掩饰。
宁苒苒走在宁荣荣与朱竹清之间，十二岁的年纪，身形却同样纤细窈窕。她穿着一身与姐姐同款的素色粗布裙，裙摆被细心地裁短至膝下，便于行动，领口绣着一圈极淡的银线暗纹。
她的头发松松地挽成一个低髻，用一根普通的木簪固定，额前碎发被晚风拂动，露出一双与宁荣荣相似却更显温润的眼眸，沉静中带着少年人特有的澄澈。
宁苒苒与朱竹清并肩而行时，会偶尔侧头说句悄悄话，两个性格迥异的小姑娘之间，竟透着一种奇妙的默契。
经过这几个月的成长，唐三和马红俊已悄然迈入十三岁的门槛，眉宇间褪去了些许稚气，多了几分沉稳；小舞、宁荣荣、宁苒苒也即将告别十二岁的青涩，少女的灵动与韧性在她们身上愈发明显。
年龄成了他们最好的伪装，十三二岁的年纪本就容易让人放松警惕，再加上她们低调的模样，更是没人会将她们与连胜的魂师联系起来。
对于大师让他们戴面具的决定，众人都极为佩服，这高瞻远瞩的安排，让他们省去了无数麻烦，也能更专注于比赛本身。
团战虽然是最后开始，但却是最先报名的。为了避免在一对一和二对二比赛中碰到彼此，影响连胜战绩，大师特意制定了周密的计划：先确定团战的分区地点，再让史莱克八怪分散到不同分区参加前两项比赛。而团战的报名工作，始终由大师以经纪人的身份亲自操办。
今天大师选择的是第八分斗魂区，他穿着一身洗得发白的灰色长袍，身形消瘦，在灯火下显得愈发深邃。
经过这一个月的斗魂，原本看似极难达到的银斗魂级别，在大家的连胜中已基本可以搞定，只需等待今日斗魂结束后统一计算积分。大师并不希望弟子们受到太多关注，一旦他们的真实年龄被挖掘出来，来自各方的拉拢、试探甚至打压将接踵而至，那无尽的麻烦足以打乱他们的成长节奏。
过早暴露身份对他们的成长并无益处，大师更希望他们能在相对安静的环境中稳步成长。
因此他已经决定，过了今天，就将带着史莱克八怪进入自己为他们安排的第三阶段试炼。

习惯性的来到团战区报名点，他有条不紊的将史莱克八怪团战的注册徽章递给工作人员声音平淡无波，却带着一种不容置疑的威严：“麻烦你，报名团战。”
工作人员指尖习惯性地接过徽章，冰凉的金属触感刚传来，目光落在那棱角分明的刻字上时，瞳孔骤然收缩，握着徽章的手指猛地收紧，竟不自觉低呼出声：“史莱克八怪？！”
这声惊呼在喧闹的报名区格外突兀，引得周围几位排队的魂师纷纷侧目。
大师眉头瞬间蹙起，眼底掠过一丝不悦。索托大斗魂场作为斗罗大陆闻名的顶级斗魂场所，其工作人员素来以沉稳专业着称，即便面对魂王、魂帝级别的强者也鲜有失态，眼前这年轻人的反应，显然超出了正常范畴。
“对不起，先生。”工作人员才意识到自己的失礼，脸颊涨得通红，却依旧难掩眼中的震惊与激动，小心翼翼地试探着问道，“请问您就是史莱克八怪的领队么？”
大师周身的气压微微沉了沉，缓缓颔首，声音平淡却带着不容置疑的催促：“算是吧。麻烦请你快一点，我们还要准备比赛。”
“先生，请您稍等！务必稍等！”工作人员连忙摆手，在大师略感惊讶的注视下，几乎是攥着那枚团战徽章，快步绕过报名台朝着工作区后方跑去，脚步急促得甚至带起了一阵风，生怕慢了半分就会错失什么。
大师立在原地，眉头皱得更紧了。他本就不喜节外生枝，如今对方拿走了报名必备的团战徽章，即便想换个分区报名也无从谈起，只能耐着性子在原地等候，心中暗自思忖：这索托大斗魂场葫芦里到底卖的什么药？
他却不知，那枚刻着“史莱克八怪”的徽章，早已在索托大斗魂场内部成为了特殊的象征。
近一个月来，这支平均年龄不足十三岁的少年队伍，从外围斗魂区一路披荆斩棘，团战未尝一败，甚至创下了连续碾压老牌强队的惊人战绩，早已被大斗魂场高层列为重点关注对象。
今日无论这枚徽章出现在哪个分区，都会引发同样的震动。
content_en:
Even if they have never set foot in the main soul fighting arena in the center, the curiosity and pursuit of these eight mysterious soul masters from the peripheral audiences have already reached an overwhelming level.
In order to avoid unnecessary trouble and entanglement, starting from ten days ago, the master set the rules: a group of people enter the spirit fighting arena with their true colors, go to the designated secret corner, put on uniform dark clothes, and put on face-covering masks before signing up for the competition.
Because of this, guessing which sub-spirit fighting area the Shrek Eight Monsters will appear in has become an endless pastime for outside spectators. Whenever a strong anonymous team appears in a certain sub-spirit fighting area, it will always trigger a heated discussion about "is it the Shrek Eight Monsters?"
It was still the same today. Everyone had put on the simplest coarse cloth clothes. The dark-colored cloth had been washed a little white, which just covered up the sharp edges that were gradually revealed on the bodies of the boys and girls.
Tang San was wearing a gray-blue shorts, with slight burrs on the cuffs, and his eyes were as calm as water, making him inconspicuous among the crowd.
Ma Hongjun's clothes were slightly loose, covering his slightly stout figure, and the occasional smirk on his lips showed a bit of youthful detachment. Xiao Wu wore a simple ponytail, her pink hair tips looming under the light, bouncing next to Ma Hongjun Tang San, her fingers unconsciously wrapped around the soft armor ribbon around her waist.
Ning Rongrong had taken off her gorgeous clothes, and her plain dress made her skin look better than snow. The arrogance that occasionally flashed between her brows still retained the look of a little princess;
Dai Mubai walked at the front to clear the way, his body as tall as a pine, his eyes as sharp as an eagle, and the aura he revealed inadvertently always made the crowd around him subconsciously give in; Oscar chewed homemade sausage and followed Ning Rongrong slowly, talking about the upcoming competition from time to time;
Zhu Zhuqing is dressed in black, and her figure is as slender as an immature beast. As the youngest member of the team, her eyes are colder and more determined than those of her peers. Her steps are light but steady. When she occasionally raises her eyes to scan around, the vigilance in her eyes is undisguised.
Ning Ranran walked between Ning Rongrong and Zhu Zhuqing. Although she was twelve years old, her figure was equally slender and graceful. She wore a plain-colored coarse cloth skirt of the same style as her sister. The skirt was carefully cut to just below the knees to facilitate movement, and the neckline was embroidered with a faint dark pattern of silver thread.
Her hair was pulled up loosely into a low bun and fixed with an ordinary wooden hairpin. The broken hair on her forehead was blown by the evening breeze, revealing a pair of eyes that were similar to Ning Rongrong but more gentle, with a calmness that was unique to young people.
When Ning Ranran and Zhu Zhuqing walked side by side, they would occasionally turn their heads and whisper. There was a wonderful tacit understanding between the two girls with very different personalities.
After these few months of growth, Tang San and Ma Hongjun have quietly entered the threshold of thirteen years old, and their brows have lost a little childishness and become a little more calm; Xiao Wu, Ning Rongrong, and Ning Ranran are also about to bid farewell to their twelve-year-old youth, and the agility and resilience of girls are becoming more and more obvious in them.
Age has become their best disguise. At the age of thirteen or twelve, it is easy for people to relax their vigilance. Coupled with their low-key appearance, no one would associate them with spirit masters who have a winning streak.
Everyone admired the master's decision to let them wear masks. This far-sighted arrangement saved them countless troubles and allowed them to focus more on the game itself.
Although the team battle starts last, they are the first to sign up. In order to avoid encountering each other in one-on-one and two-on-two matches and affecting the winning streak, the master specially formulated a careful plan: first determine the division location of the team battle, and then let the Shrek Eight Monsters disperse to different divisions to participate in the first two games. The registration for team battles is always handled by the master personally as an agent.
Today, the master chose the eighth division of the fighting spirit area. He was wearing a gray robe that had been washed white. His figure was thin and looked even deeper under the light.
After this month of soul fighting, it originally seemed extremely difficult to achieveThe level of Silver Soul Fighting can be basically achieved in everyone's winning streak. You only need to wait for the unified calculation of points after the end of today's Soul Fighting. The master does not want his disciples to receive too much attention. Once their true ages are discovered, wooing, testing and even suppression from all sides will follow, and the endless troubles will be enough to disrupt their growth rhythm.
Exposing their identity prematurely will not be beneficial to their growth. The master hopes that they can grow steadily in a relatively quiet environment.
Therefore, he has decided that after today, he will take the Shrek Eight Monsters into the third stage of the trial that he has arranged for them.
He habitually came to the registration point of the team battle area, and methodically handed the registration badge for the Shrek Eight Monsters team battle to the staff. His voice was calm, but with an unquestionable dignity: "Please, sign up for the team battle."
The staff member habitually took the badge with his fingertips. The cold metal touch just came. When his eyes fell on the sharp-edged lettering, his pupils suddenly shrank. The fingers holding the badge tightened suddenly, and he unconsciously exclaimed: "Shrek Eight Monsters?!"
This exclamation was particularly abrupt in the noisy registration area, attracting the side glances of several soul masters queuing around.
The master's brows instantly furrowed, and a trace of displeasure flashed across his eyes. As the top soul fighting venue famous in Douluo Continent, the staff of Soto Grand Soul Fighting Arena are known for their calmness and professionalism. They rarely lose their composure even when faced with powerful soul kings and soul emperors. The reaction of the young man in front of him was obviously beyond the normal range.
"I'm sorry, sir." The staff member realized his rudeness, his cheeks turned red, but he still couldn't hide the shock and excitement in his eyes, and asked cautiously, "Are you the leader of the Shrek Eight Monsters?"
The air pressure around the master's body sank slightly, and he nodded slowly, his voice calm but with an unmistakable urging: "That's right. Please hurry up, we have to prepare for the competition."
"Sir, please wait a moment! Please wait a moment!" The staff member waved his hands quickly. Under the slightly surprised gaze of the master, he almost clutched the team battle badge and quickly ran around the registration desk towards the back of the work area. His pace was so fast that it even brought up a gust of wind, for fear that if he was half a minute slower, he would miss something.
The master stood there, his brows frowning even more. He didn't like extraneous matters, but now that the other party had taken away the team battle badge necessary for registration, even if he wanted to change the division to register, he couldn't do it. He could only wait patiently where he was, thinking to himself: What kind of medicine is sold in the gourd of this Soto Great Soul Fighting Arena?
Little did he know that the badge with "Shrek's Eight Monsters" engraved on it had already become a special symbol inside the Soto Spirit Arena.
In the past month, this young team, with an average age of less than thirteen years old, has been fighting all the way from the outer spirit fighting area without losing a single team fight. It has even set an astonishing record of continuously crushing established and powerful teams. It has already been listed as a key target of attention by the senior leaders of the big fighting spirit field.
No matter which division this badge appears today, it will cause the same shock.
